claims: "FAF5" was popularized by Brock Lesnar in 2026.
"FAF5" stems from the slang "F*** around and find out" (FAFO).
F5 references Brock Lesnar's signature fireman's carry facebuster finisher.
"FAF5" shirts were often worn during Brock Lesnar's feud with Seth Rollins.
There is a 55s YouTube video by HowToWrestle uploaded on Apr 14, 2010 that demonstrates the technique for performing the F-5 move.
"FAF5" was highlighted on WWE Raw in March 2026.
The highlighting of "FAF5" on WWE Raw in March 2026 followed a segment where Seth Rollins attacked Paul Heyman.
WWE Shop released a black "FAF5" T-shirt.
The black "FAF5" T-shirt has been featured heavily during Brock Lesnar's 2026 appearances.
Brock Lesnar's F-5 finisher involves lifting an opponent into a fireman’s carry, spinning them, and throwing them face-first onto the mat, notes Pro Wrestling | Fandom.
